from vpython import *

G = 6.378e-11
RE = 6.378e6
ME = 5.972e24
rod = cylinder(pos = vec(0,RE*1.2,0),axis=vec(RE*0.08,0,0), radius=RE*0.05, color = vec(1,0,0))

Earth=sphere(pos=vec(0,0,0), radius = RE, texture=textures.earth)
Earth.m=ME
Earth.p=Earth.m*vec(0,0,0)

b=sphere(pos=vec(0,RE*1.2,0), radius =RE*0.03, make_trail= True)
b.m=100
b.p=b.m*vec(7000,0,0)

t=0
dt=1

while True :
    rate(500)
    r=b.pos-Earth.pos
    F=-G*Earth.m*b.m*norm(r)/mag(r)**2
    b.p=b.p+F*dt
    b.pos=b.pos+b.p*dt/b.m
    t=t+dt
